description.value: Captain's Oven Pizza is a Neapolitan-style pizza restaurant that bakes its hand-tossed pies in a custom 3-ton stone brick oven shipped directly from Regello, Tuscany, cooking each pizza in about two minutes at up to 1,000 degrees. The Langley location on Fraser Highway is one of five BC locations, offering a broad menu of artisan pizzas made with imported Italian ingredients like fior di latte and grana padano. Cyclists passing through Langley will find a full sit-down restaurant experience with online ordering and local delivery also available.
